title: Pulse Stretcher
statement: Design a pulse stretcher that extends a single-cycle input pulse on a 1-bit signal into a two-cycle output pulse. The module should assert the output for the cycle where the input pulse is detected and the following clock cycle. A synchronous reset clears the output and internal state to zero.
module_signature: module pulse_stretcher(input clk, input rst, input pulse_in, output reg pulse_out);
behavior: pulse_out is high for two clock cycles after pulse_in is high for one cycle.
pulse_out is low when pulse_in is low and no stored extension exists.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use asynchronous edge detection or latches.
hint: Capture the pulse and use stored state to produce a second cycle of output.
